summary: An abstract brain training game with relaxing AI-made art
description: Shapes offers you endless puzzles where the outcome is always abstract, yet harmonious and beautiful. It's a different way of playing a Logic Game such that you can relax while training your brain. With Shapes, you need to rotate the different pieces to uncover an harmonious, hidden figure, usually abstract. Once the neon lights are on, you win another battle and the level is completed. It is a brain training experience and mind relaxation that initially will help you with your logic skills but after a while, it will be the gateway to help you with stress, anxiety relief. Through an immersive abstract environment of countless challenging levels, this game will guide you into an anti-stress relaxation journey. Key Features: 1. Endless Levels (Infinite). The levels are not random. Level 38.600 will be the same for you and your friends; 2. Perfect for Offline Gaming since you don't need an internet connection; 3. Purely Abstract Generation of Shapes using our Proprietary AI Algorithm; 4. A Pure Logic and Brain Training Game at Start; 5. 100% Relaxing Game after level 100; 6. Minimalist Art and Gameplay. Experiment with a relaxing and spatial environment, enjoying a soothing soundtrack and exciting puzzles. In this game we merge figures within classical traits and futuristic neon lights with the purpose to play with your senses, imagination and logic. Considered by players as one of the best efforts ever released by Infinity Games this the perfect offline game for fans of beautiful brain teaser games. Accept our challenge and bring some order to this topsy-turvy world! Do you like our work?
